name: Vergara (Colombia)
description: Horizontal bicolour of yellow and green, charged at the centre with the municipal arms of Vergara (a tree on a hill on white, within a laurel wreath, with the mottoes DIOS PATRIA and CIENCIA LIBERTAD).
history: Municipal flag of Vergara, a municipality in the department of Cundinamarca, Colombia; Colombian municipal flags are adopted by agreement (acuerdo) of the municipal council or by decree of the mayor.

features.role: Vergara arms — tree on a hill on white, within a laurel wreath, with mottoes DIOS PATRIA and CIENCIA LIBERTAD
